findings.title: Eval Injection
findings.explanation: The expression is constructed from user-controlled values and then evaluated using eval(). An attacker can manipulate the terms and operators to execute arbitrary JavaScript code.
findings.attack_sketch: An attacker could craft an expression like `1 * (1; alert('xss'))` to execute a JavaScript alert.
findings.needs_to_confirm: Check if there are any other parts of the application that use eval() or similar functions.

safe_notes: lines 14-19: Math.random() is used for generating terms and operators, but these are not directly controlled by the user and are not used in the eval() context, so they do not pose a risk.
